frontend.prompt:
[FACT:request-title-trim] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.trim = "U+0020"
[FACT:request-title-length-unit] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.length_unit = "unicode_code_point"
[FACT:request-title-min-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.min_length = 3
[FACT:request-title-max-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.max_length = 80
[FACT:create-title-required] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) create.title.required = true
[FACT:update-title-required] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) update.title.required = false
[FACT:request-title-nullable] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.nullable = false
[FACT:request-title-invalid-status] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.invalid_status = 422
[FACT:update-title-omission] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) update.title.omission = "unchanged"

Summary:
- Trim leading and trailing U+0020 characters from title before any client-side validation or before sending to the server.
- Measure title length in Unicode code points.
- Allowed length: inclusive 3..80 code points.
- On create (POST /api/v1/items/) title must be provided (non-omitted and non-null). On update (PUT /api/v1/items/{id}) title may be omitted; omission means leave the stored value unchanged.
- Explicit null for title is not allowed; if client sends title: null, expect 422 and show an error.
- Backend stores and returns the processed (trimmed) value; the frontend must use the returned value as source-of-truth after successful responses.
- Permissions and description rules are unchanged.

Frontend implementation checklist:
1. Input handling
   - On blur (and immediately before submit), remove leading and trailing U+0020 (ASCII space) characters from the text value. Do not remove other whitespace code points.
   - For length checks use Unicode code points count (not bytes, not UTF-16 code units). E.g. count extended code points properly.
2. Validation rules (client-side, mirror backend):
   - After trimming, require length >= 3 and <= 80 code points.
   - If trimmed string is empty or consists only of U+0020 characters (resulting in empty after trimming), treat as invalid.
   - Prevent sending title: null from the UI (since nullable = false). If the user clears the field, show a validation error instead of sending null on update or send a removal omission (i.e., omit the key) only if the UX intends to keep the original value; but note that create requires a non-omitted title.
3. Submit behavior
   - POST /api/v1/items/: always include title in the request body and ensure it meets validation; if missing or null, do not send and surface a client error because create.title.required = true.
   - PUT /api/v1/items/{id}: if user did not change the title field, omit the title property from the JSON body to leave it unchanged. If user intentionally sets title to an empty string or some text, include the trimmed value (but do not send null). If the client sends title: null, expect a 422 response.
4. Error handling
   - Map 422 responses from the server to the title field and display server-provided message; for client-side preflight failures, show inline messages identical in wording/priority.
   - Test that lengths 2 and 81 (after trimming) are considered invalid and produce validation errors; lengths 3 and 80 are accepted.
   - Treat all-space input as invalid because trimming removes all U+0020.
5. Post-success
   - After a successful create or update, use the title value returned by the server (the stored, processed/trimmed value) to populate the UI/state.
6. Test cases to implement in frontend test suite
   - Create requests: trimmed length 2 -> client reject or server 422; trimmed length 3 -> success; trimmed length 80 -> success; trimmed length 81 -> client reject or server 422.
   - Update requests: omitting title -> do not change stored value (verify via GET after update); sending trimmed length 2 -> 422; sending trimmed length 3 -> success; sending explicit null -> server returns 422 and UI surfaces error.

Notes for developers:
- Use a Unicode-aware code-point counting utility. Do not use simple string.length in environments where that counts code units.
- Only trim U+0020; do not strip other whitespace characters (e.g., U+00A0). The trim operation must be exactly: remove U+0020 from both ends.
- Keep permission/description checks unchanged and do not modify other fields serialization.

[FACT:request-title-length-unit] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.length_unit = "unicode_code_point"
[FACT:request-title-min-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.min_length = 3
[FACT:request-title-max-length] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.max_length = 80
[FACT:create-title-required] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) create.title.required = true
[FACT:update-title-required] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) update.title.required = false
[FACT:request-title-nullable] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.nullable = false
[FACT:request-title-invalid-status] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.title.invalid_status = 422
[FACT:update-title-omission] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) update.title.omission = "unchanged"

Summary:
- On both POST /api/v1/items/ and PUT /api/v1/items/{id}, trim leading and trailing U+0020 from incoming request.title before any validation or storage.
- Measure length in Unicode code points.
- Valid lengths after trimming: 3..80 inclusive. If invalid, respond with status 422.
- For POST (create): title is required. If title is omitted or null, respond 422.
- For PUT (update): title is optional. If title is omitted from the request body, do not modify the stored title (leave unchanged). If title is present but null, respond 422.
- Backend must persist and return the processed (trimmed) title value in responses.
- Permissions and description rules remain unchanged.

Backend implementation checklist:
1. Request processing order
   - If request body contains a title field (even empty string), first perform trimming of U+0020 on both ends of that string.
   - After trimming, validate nullability and length in code points.
2. Validation rules
   - If title is null (explicit JSON null) -> return 422 with field-level error (request.title.invalid_status = 422).
   - If title is omitted in POST -> return 422 because create.title.required = true.
   - If title is omitted in PUT -> do not change the stored title (update.title.omission = "unchanged").
   - After trimming, if code point length < 3 or > 80 -> return 422. This covers cases where trimming turns a string of spaces into empty.
   - Ensure that strings that are only U+0020 count as empty after trimming and are rejected.
3. Storage and response
   - Persist the trimmed string as the canonical stored title.
   - On successful POST/PUT, return the resource representation containing the stored title (the trimmed value) so the frontend can synchronize.
4. Error responses
   - Use 422 for all violations described above. Include machine-readable and human-readable field error details indicating that title must be 3..80 Unicode code points after trimming and may not be null.
5. Edge cases & testing
   - Test cases: trimmed length 2 -> 422; trimmed length 3 -> success; trimmed length 80 -> success; trimmed length 81 -> 422.
   - Test that a title consisting only of U+0020 is rejected (becomes empty after trimming) with 422.
   - Test update omission: PUT without title leaves stored title unchanged.
   - Test explicit null on update or create returns 422.
6. Implementation notes
   - Use a Unicode-aware code-point counting routine; do not rely on byte length or UTF-16 code units.
   - Trim only U+0020 characters from the ends; do not normalize or remove other Unicode whitespace code points.
   - Keep existing permission and description validation unchanged; this change only affects title handling.

API specifics to document for clients:
- POST /api/v1/items/ expects a JSON body including title (required, non-null). Invalid title -> 422.
- PUT /api/v1/items/{id} accepts a JSON body where title is optional; omission = unchanged. Explicit null -> 422.
- On success, responses include the stored (trimmed) title.
